run_winoground_evaluation: run the winoground evaluation on a CLIP model using the facebook/winoground test dataset
run_clip_model_evaluation: run a CLIP model and processor through the winoground benchmark to get text image and group scores
evaluate_clip_scores: evaluate four independent image-caption CLIP scores for each winoground example and compute accuracy metrics
test_winoground_text_correct: test the text_correct function to verify caption 0 matches image 0 and caption 1 matches image 1
test_winoground_group_correct: test the group_correct function to verify both text and image correctness for a winoground result
